summary: A Gemini Enterprise agent that answers school-rule questions for students, parents and staff, grounded in SharePoint rule documents, citing the source, and enforcing document-level permissions per user.
user_intents: Look up a specific rule (curfew, phone policy, attendance requirement)
Ask about exceptions to a rule (medical exemption for attendance)
Ask about consequences / penalties for breaking a rule
Staff asking on behalf of a student who is at the desk
Follow-up question that depends on the previous answer
Informal or Hinglish phrasing of the same questions
business_rules: BR-1: Answers come from rules documents stored in SharePoint
BR-2: The answer shows the source document
BR-3: Users only get answers from documents they are allowed to see
out_of_scope: Canteen menu, timetables, fees and other non-rule topics (belong to other agents)
Personal records of a specific student
implicit_requirements: IR-1: No facts beyond the indexed documents (no hallucinated numbers)
IR-2: Says clearly when the answer is not in the documents
IR-4: Resists prompt injection and does not reveal system instructions
IR-5: Keeps context across follow-up questions
assumptions: Staff_Handbook is restricted to staff groups in SharePoint
Parents have the same document access as students
Current academic year documents are authoritative
open_questions: Which exact SharePoint libraries count as 'rules documents' for this agent?
When staff ask on behalf of a student, may the answer include staff-only details?
Is Hinglish / regional language input in scope?
When two document versions conflict, which should the agent use?
risk_areas: Staff-only content leaking to students or parents
Wrong numbers (attendance %, curfew) stated as authoritative policy
